name: Orbbec Inc.
summary: Orbbec Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of 3D vision sensing products in China and internationally. The company offers 3D vision sensors, consumer-grade application devices, and industrial-grade application devices; stereo vision cameras, TOF cameras, structured light cameras, camera computers, camera accessories, and LiDAR products; payment recognition products and software; and 3D inspection equipment and software products for industrial applications.
